title: Physical and Mental Wellbeing
text: Explore how to maintain your health, manage stress, and create realistic goals to improve your wellbeing.
cdi_links: 4.B.02 Reflecting on their physical and mental wellbeing and considering how they can improve it

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore:
bullets: How to recognise when wellbeing needs attention
Strategies to reduce stress
How to set realistic wellbeing goals
Ways to maintain balance as responsibilities grow
You will evaluate your current routines and plan small changes to improve your health.

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can identify signs of stress or low wellbeing
I can describe strategies to improve physical and mental health
I can set a realistic goal to improve my wellbeing
I can plan simple steps to maintain balance in my life

title: Key Words
bullets: Self-Care – Actions that help you stay healthy and happy.
Self-Assessment – Reviewing your habits and thinking about what you need.
Stress Management – Techniques to handle pressure or difficult feelings.

title: Quick Questions
bullets: What do you do to take care of yourself each day?
Which activities make you feel relaxed or happy?
Which tasks or routines make you feel stressed or tired?

title: How to Maintain Wellbeing
bullets: Exercise – Keeps your body healthy and reduces stress
Sleep – Supports concentration, mood, and energy
Healthy Eating – Fuels the body and brain

title: How to Maintain Wellbeing
bullets: Relaxation & Mindfulness – Helps manage pressure
Talking to Someone – Sharing worries with friends, family, or mentors
Digital Boundaries – Limiting screen time for mental rest

title: Activity
text: Current habits that support wellbeing & Habits or routines that could be improved

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Wellbeing is both physical and mental
Small, realistic goals build lasting habits
Reflection and planning help you manage stress
Maintaining balance supports longterm success and happiness
